scope: operational continuity only; no prediction, outcome, ranking or economic rule changes
reason: Wall-clock gaps can reflect table inactivity. A fixed 300-second clock threshold alone can quarantine a complete authoritative event sequence even when no round is missing.

policy.authoritativeAdjacencyDefinition: The persisted previous round must be present verbatim in the recovered same-source union and the first fresh round must be the immediately following event in that ordered authoritative union; every subsequent recovered pair must also be consecutive in that same recovered union.
